title: Rainbow Six Siege Y11S4 Operation Vital Signal: Doc rework (remote heal and revive), MBZ-19, ranked split, Bank rework; DOOM Slayer elite set 22 Dec
label: رسمي

sources.name: Ubisoft press release, reprinted in full by Famitsu (16 Nov 2026 18:00 JST)
Ubisoft, Rainbow Six Siege news (Y11S4 reveal at the Osaka Major)

first_report: Ubisoft reveal at the Osaka Major; Ubisoft Japan press release reprinted by Famitsu 16 Nov 2026 18:00 JST (09:00Z); first seen by the server watch 09:15Z
footage: stills: n/a. The Operation Vital Signal trailer is on YouTube only (yt-dlp refused with a sign-in check, 28 Sep rule); Steam carries only the Y11S3 Launch Trailer, used as credited earlier footage of the same game

angle.hook: DOOM Slayer is coming to Rainbow Six Siege as an elite set on 22 Dec
angle.why_now: Ubisoft revealed the Year 11 final season, Operation Vital Signal, today
angle.what_it_means_here: Doc can now heal and revive teammates from a distance, and ranked splits into Solo/Duo and Flex
angle.payoff: the DOOM Slayer set on 22 Dec

director_sendbacks.note: DOOM Slayer is named in the headline and the payoff line but never shown: both sit on Doc's Vital Signal key art, so a viewer reads Doc as the DOOM Slayer skin. Open (shot 0) and close (shot 5, line 3) on official DOOM Slayer art from id Software/Bethesda's press kit, credited on screen as a stand-in; keep the rest as built.

director_check.note: Send-back fixed: the DOOM Slayer is now on screen at the hook (0-3.8 s) and at the payoff (16.2-19.3 s), credited as DOOM: The Dark Ages art, and Doc's remote-heal line sits on the Vital Signal key art. All lines, credits and headline open on Arabic, no flipped signs, inside the safe zone; nothing graphic; last 2 s a picture. Weak: shot 1 shows the back of an operator's shoulder, not a face; the two ranked emblems look alike; the Slayer still is DOOM's own art, not the Siege skin itself.
director_check.looked: 1: DOOM Slayer close-up under chip رسمي and the two-line headline, readable at grid size; 2: Solo/Duo ranked emblem with credit and the ranked-split line; 3: DOOM Slayer close-up with its credit and the 22 Dec line, dimmed into the end-card fade
